description: RAM-SCB couples a kinetic ring-current calculation with a three-dimensional magnetic-equilibrium solver. It estimates particle distributions and field structure for studies of storm-time inner-magnetosphere behaviour. The resource is documented by LANL. The documented physical domain is Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / RingCurrent; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request, Public Repository. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The hosted configuration uses statistical plasma boundaries and a geomagnetic-index-dependent electric field. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
